Name: Ser Robar Royce
Quirks: speaks with the easy confidence of a man who is good at what he does and knows it
references tournaments and martial reputation naturally
his loyalty to Renly is genuine and a little starry-eyed - he believes in the king he chose
CharacterDescription: Ser Robar Royce known as Robar the Red for his red-dyed armor is the second son of Yohn Royce - a tourney knight who has made a name for himself in the lists across the realm. He is in his early twenties, charismatic, skilled, somewhat in the shadow of his father's expectations while carving his own reputation. He has joined Renly Baratheon's Rainbow Guard - Renly's Kingsguard - drawn by Renly's style and generosity and the sense that Renly represents something worth fighting for. It has made him somewhat estranged from his father's more cautious politics.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Ser Robar Royce also known as Robar the Red is a knight from House Royce and is the second eldest son of the Lord of Runestone. He has aspirations to serve as a Kingsguard.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: With Renly Baratheon's host in the Stormlands two days before Ned's execution.
